title: Cookie settings
intro: This page explains which cookies soliance-enr.fr stores, what they are for, how long they are kept, and how to change your choice at any time.

status.label: Your current choice:
status.UNDECIDED: you have not made a choice yet.

what.title: What is a cookie?
what.body: A cookie is a small file stored on your device when you visit a website. It lets the site, or a third-party service, recognise your browser on your next visits.

necessary.title: What is stored without your consent
necessary.body: Only your cookie choice is stored, in your browser's local storage, so that we do not ask again on every page. It serves no other purpose and is shared with no one.

analytics.title: Audience measurement, only with your consent
analytics.body: If you accept it, we use Google Analytics to learn which pages are viewed, how many requests are sent from our forms and how many visitors click on our phone numbers. These statistics help us improve the site. No measurement cookie is stored until you accept.
analytics.provider: Google Analytics is provided by Google Ireland Limited. Data may be transferred to the United States under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

list.title: Cookie list
list.caption: Cookies and trackers used on soliance-enr.fr

consent.name: soliance-consent
consent.purpose: Remembers your cookie choice (browser local storage)

gaSession.name: _ga_<id>
gaSession.purpose: Keeps the state of the visit for audience measurement

duration.title: How long your choice is kept
duration.body: Your choice is kept for 6 months. After that, we ask you again.

withdraw.title: Changing your mind
withdraw.body: You can accept, refuse or withdraw your consent at any time with the « Change my choices » button on this page, reachable from the « Cookie settings » link at the bottom of every page. If you withdraw your consent, the audience measurement cookies are deleted. You can also block or clear cookies from your browser settings.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: The site is published by Solar Trade SAS, 30 avenue du Général Leclerc, 06700 Saint-Laurent-du-Var. For any question about cookies, write to adv@soliance-enr.fr. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
